confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated 2026 Tokyo price guides (Numbeo-derived, Expatica, Wise, whereandwhen, citycost, Expatistan, Bootsnall) plus izakaya and hotel-menu listings. Wine and cocktail prices are less certain than restaurant and beer prices, and the wine glass anchor is a judgment call from thin 2026 data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or live booking pages were inspected. The yen-to-dollar conversions used for food and drink were not separately searched and assume an approximate rate near 150 JPY per USD, so food and drink anchors may shift if the yen moved materially. The FX observation came from a search-result snippet for the RBA 4.00 pm rate on 2026-11-18, not a page read; no 19 November observation was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Tokyo-specific aggregated price data; accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for Tokyo as a major East Asian capital.
